categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label, touches `BlockTemplateManager` and `rpc/mining.cpp`, and refactors the `getblocktemplate` caching logic.
categories.rationale: Cleans up node lifetime and global state by moving static template caching into `BlockTemplateManager`. As noted in the description, this prevents 'cached CBlockIndex* can outlive its ChainstateManager (as in unit tests)', enables compile-time thread safety checks, and adds unit testing coverage for template invalidation.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Does not change RPC interfaces, argument handling, or output; only extracts internal mining template caching logic out of `rpc/mining.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Category covers node programmatic interfaces and RPC machinery, whereas changes to the underlying subsystem behavior exposed by an RPC belong to that subsystem.
